verdict_reason: Imagery (S1/S2) and AlphaEarth embeddings are open via free GEE/Copernicus catalogs, fitting C9. But no open EU dataset of parcel-level insured hail/frost damage exists: ESSL ESWD is non-commercial, application-gated, and only reports events, not claims; Spanish/Austrian insurer pages were unreachable. Ground truth needs construction or an insurer partnership.

ground_truth.construction_protocol: No open EU parcel-level insured hail/frost dataset found. Construct weak labels: match ESWD hail-event dates/locations to LPIS/EuroCrops parcels within radius, using S1/S2 pre-post change + AlphaEarth distance as damage proxy; seek insurer partnership to validate.

compute_path.platform: Google Earth Engine (S1/S2/AlphaEarth catalogs) + Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
compute_path.why: S1, S2, and AlphaEarth embeddings are all served pre-processed via free GEE/Copernicus catalogs; no local training required, fits MacBook-no-CUDA rule.

notes: Crux: no open EU source publishes parcel-level insured hail/frost claims. ESSL ESWD is crowd-sourced weather-event reports (point-level, non-commercial, application-gated), not insurance data. Agroseguro-Spain and Hagelversicherung-Austria pages were unreachable (404 / TLS mismatch) - need direct partner outreach. Copernicus EMS activations are disaster-specific, rarely agri-hail-focused. Recommend insurer partnership or ESWD-date weak-labeling.
